faq.q: What are the house-size rules on ALR land in Abbotsford?
faq.a: Under the ALC's housing guidance, a principal residence on ALR land is capped at a total floor area of 500 m² or less, a secondary suite is permitted only within the principal residence, and an additional residence is limited to 90 m² on properties of 40 ha or less and 186 m² on properties over 40 ha.

faq.q: How much property transfer tax will I pay on a home over $1.8M?
faq.a: Under the Province's general PTT rates — 1% on the first $200,000, 2% on the portion above $200,000 up to and including $2,000,000, and 3% on the portion above $2,000,000, plus a further 2% on the residential portion of value above $3,000,000 — a home in this band is taxed mostly in the 2% tier, with only the value above $2,000,000 in the 3% tier.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Abbotsford?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Abbotsford?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
